page_title: PIS 0-1 BOL | Pisa v Bologna 02/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) is coming onto the pitch as Antonio Caracciolo cannot continue after picking up an injury.

90' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Jens Odgaard (Bologna) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Nicolas Andrade just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
87' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle as Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
85' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

84' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Pisa.
82' A yellow card for bad language! Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
81' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa).
80' The corner from Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) is cleared away by the defence.
79' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

78' A pass into the box finds Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Lukasz Skorupski denies him. Pisa win a corner.
76' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
76' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Remo Freuler (Bologna) takes it short.
74' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Joao Mario is replaced by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
74' Substitution. Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) in, Nicolo Cambiaghi out.

74' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal.
74' Bologna take a short corner kick.

73' Santiago Castro (Bologna) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Bologna earn a corner.
72' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
72' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is about to take a corner kick.
70' Oscar Hiljemark decides to make a substitution. Arturo Calabresi will be replaced by Simone Canestrelli (Pisa).
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Malthe Hojholt will be replaced by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
69' Marius Marin (Pisa) brings an opponent down and Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game.
67' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
66' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Simon Sohm.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Federico Bernardeschi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
63' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to make a change. Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) replaces Rafiu Durosinmi.
63' A substitution has been made. Samuele Angori is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
62' Pisa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is unmarked in the penalty area and heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper stops his attempt by pulling off a fine save.
61' Pisa fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
60' Samuele Angori (Pisa) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Skorupski punches the ball away.
55' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Pisa.
54' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
53' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Remo Freuler (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
50' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

48' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
46' Referee Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
45+3' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
45+2' Joao Mario (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Nicolas Andrade comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+1' Samuele Angori (Pisa) is adjudged offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
43' Bologna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
38' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' An accurate cross picks out Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
35' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Santiago Castro (Bologna), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the left post. He did everything right but score!
34' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
32' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

28' What a chance that is! Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
26' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) is penalised for a foul. Ermano Feliciani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
24' Santiago Castro (Bologna) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
21' Vincenzo Italiano is forced to make a change. Martin Vitik is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nicolo Casale (Bologna).
20' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
15' Samuele Angori (Pisa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
14' Remo Freuler (Bologna) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
10' Referee Ermano Feliciani sees the trip by Nadir Zortea (Bologna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
9' Martin Vitik (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' Marius Marin (Pisa) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
7' The ball is cleared after Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bologna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
Bologna will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
